users_email_or_phone.name: users_email_or_phone
users_email_or_phone.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."phone" is not null

enrollments_validated.name: enrollments_validated
enrollments_validated.value: "enrollments"."status" <> 'enrolled' or ("enrollments"."validation_mode" is not null and "enrollments"."validated_at" is not null)

enrollments_left.name: enrollments_left
enrollments_left.value: "enrollments"."status" <> 'left' or ("enrollments"."exit_date" is not null and "enrollments"."exit_reason" is not null)

cash_closures_reopened.name: cash_closures_reopened
cash_closures_reopened.value: "cash_closures"."status" = 'closed' or ("cash_closures"."reopened_by" is not null and "cash_closures"."reopened_at" is not null and "cash_closures"."reopen_reason" is not null)

invoices_cancelled.name: invoices_cancelled
invoices_cancelled.value: "invoices"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("invoices"."cancelled_at" is not null and "invoices"."cancel_reason" is not null)

payment_cancellations_decided.name: payment_cancellations_decided
payment_cancellations_decided.value: "payment_cancellations"."status" = 'pending' or ("payment_cancellations"."decided_by" is not null and "payment_cancellations"."decided_at" is not null)

payments_kind.name: payments_kind
payments_kind.value:
("payments"."kind" = 'payment' and "payments"."amount" between 1 and 100000000 and "payments"."receipt_number" is not null and "payments"."reverses_id" is null)
        or ("payments"."kind" = 'reversal' and "payments"."amount" < 0 and "payments"."receipt_number" is null and "payments"."reverses_id" is not null)
